day_local: Ciidda Malaa'igta Mikaa'iil, Jabriil, iyo Raafi'iil
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha iyo Wiilka iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix ha idinla jirto.
penitential: Rabbiyow, noo naxariiso. Masiixow, noo naxariiso. Rabbiyow, noo naxariiso.
psalm_response: Indhaha malaa'igta hortooda ayaan ammaantaada u gabyi doonaa, Rabbiyow.
homily:
Maanta, markaan u dabaaldegeyno malaa'igta waaweyn ee Mikaa'iil, Jabriil, iyo Raafi'iil, waxaan ka fekerayaa sawirka cirka oo u furan sidii albaab weyn oo iftiin leh. Injiilka maanta wuxuu inoo sheegayaa ballanqaad cajiib ah: 'Waxaad arki doontaa samada oo u furan, iyo malaa'igta Ilaah oo kor u kacaya oo hoos ugu soo degaya Wiilka Aadanaha.' Waxaan rabaa inaad sawirato in aysan jirin wax fog oo u dhexeeya dhulka iyo samada. Waxaa jira buundo, waxaana buundadaas ah Ciise Masiix. 

Benjamin Vo, wiilkeenna qaaliga ah, wuxuu ahaa qof aad u jeclaa inuu wax walba fahmo. Xusuusta aan ka hayno Ben ee ah wiilka ku fadhiya garoonka diyaaradaha, isagoo indhihiisa waaweyn ku eegaya diyaaradaha 737 ee cirka ku sii jeeda, waxay inoo sheegaysaa wax ku saabsan naftiisa. Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil cirka eegayay mar walba. Wuxuu jeclaa inuu wax dhiso, inuu codeeyo, inuu qorsheeyo 'Con Chim Airlines'. Wuxuu ahaa wiil maskaxdiisu ay mar walba ka shaqaynaysay sidii uu dunida u gaari lahaa. Laakiin maanta, markaan akhrinayno Daniel 7, waxaan arkaynaa mid ka weyn diyaarad kasta ama mishiin kasta. Waxaan arkaynaa 'Mid u eg Wiilka Aadanaha' oo loo dhiibay dawladnimo iyo ammaan weligeed ah. 

Alan iyo Thao, waxaan ogahay in saddexdan bilood ay dareemayeen sida socod dheer oo mugdi ah. Waxaan ogahay in markaad qolka Ben gashaan, aad dareemaysaan in wax walba ay weli halkoodii yaalliin, laakiin Ben uusan halkaas joogin. Waxaa laga yaabaa inaad is-weydiinaysaan: 'Xaggee buu Ben hadda joogaa?' Injiilku wuxuu inoo sheegayaa in samada ay u furan tahay Wiilka Aadanaha. Ben wuxuu ku jiraa gacmaha Ciise. Wuxuu ku jiraa meel aanay jirin xanuun, meel aanay jirin daal, meel aanay jirin baahida loo qabo in la sugo diyaarad ama la dhiso shirkad. Wuxuu ku jiraa 'Banquet of Heaven', halkaas oo uu ku nasanayo isagoo dhoola caddaynaya, sida uu mar walba u sameyn jiray.

Waxaan rabaa inaan si gaar ah ula hadlo waalidka. Waxaan ogahay in mararka qaarkood aad dareemaysaan culeys ah inaad wax qaldan samayseen, ama aad wax seegteen. Fadlan, maanta, dhagayso erayadan: Ma jiro wax aad seegteen. Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil Ilaah u dhiibay gacmihiinna si aad u korisaan, idinkuna waad u koriseen si qurux badan. Jacaylka aad u muujiseen, safarradii aad u kaxayseen, iyo xitaa sheekooyinkii uu aabbihiis u sheegi jiray ee uu Ben si taxaddar leh u dhagaysan jiray—taasi waa waxa dhabta ah. Xanuunka iyo dhimashada aan la fileynin ee soo martay Ben ma aha ciqaab. Ilaah ma aha mid ciqaaba waalidka. Sida Ciise u sheegay xertiisa markii la weydiiyay sababta uu ninku u dhashay indhoolaha, 'Ma aha ninkan iyo waalidkiis toona.' Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, wuxuuna idinla joogaa murugadan.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, waan ogahay in dunidaadu ay isbeddeshay. Waxaan ogahay in kursiga agtaada ah uu mararka qaarkood u muuqdo mid madhan. Laakiin xusuuso, Ben wuxuu kula joogaa jacaylka aad u hayso. Wuxuu kula joogaa xasuusyada aad wadaagteen, sida markii aad wada raacdeen 'roller coaster' ee aad ku riyootay. Ha ka cabsan inaad noolaato, ha ka cabsan inaad ku raaxaysato nolosha, waayo Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad faraxdo. Wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu mar walba jeclaa. 

Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil qalbi weyn leh. Xusuuso markuu 15 sano jir ahaa, ee uu u sheegay waalidkiis inuu rabay inuu siiyo dhammaan lacagta sanduuqiisa yar si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William oo xanuunsanayd. Ma uusan jebin sanduuqa, mana loo baahnayn, laakiin rabitaankaas safka hore kaga jiray ee ahaa inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto waa xigmadda dhabta ah ee Masiixu inoo sheegayo. Taasi waa jacayl aan xisaab lahayn, jacayl aan sugin mahadcelin, jacayl si fudud u bixiya naftiisa. Ben wuxuu baray qoyskiisa in jacaylku aanu ahayn waxa aad haysato, laakiin waa waxa aad diyaar u tahay inaad bixiso. 

Maanta, markaan u dabaaldegeyno malaa'igta, aan xusuusano in Ben uu hadda la safan yahay malaa'igta. Wuxuu naga caawinayaa inaan aragno in Ilaah uu inoo dhow yahay. Markaad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaado hal shay oo yar: Ha ku tiirsanaan xigmaddaada marka culaysku yimaado. U dhiib qalbigaaga Ciise. Ha joojiso inaad is-eedeyso. Ogow in Ben uu ku jiro nabadda iyo gacmaha Aabbaha, oo uu halkaas idinku sugayo. Ben wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay meel nabdoon, wuxuuna idin leeyahay: 'Haku murugoonina si xad dhaaf ah; waan idin daawanayaa.'

Jacaylka Ben wuxuu weli ku nool yahay adduunkan. Sida ceelka biyaha ee Cà Mau, ee uu magaciisa ku qoran yahay, jacaylkiisu wuxuu u socdaa dadka harraadsan, isagoo u keenaya nolol iyo rajo. Sidaas oo kale, qalbiyadiinna ha u furnaadaan rajo cusub. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciiseow, waxaan aaminsanahay inaad ku sugan tahay Sacrament-ka Quduuska ah. Waxaan kaa jeclahay wax walba, waxaana rabaa inaan kugu qaato naftayda. Maadaama aanan hadda kugu qaadan karin Sacrament-ka, fadlan igu soo booqo ruux ahaan qalbigayga. Waxaan ku duubmayaa sidaad adigu ii duubtay, hana ii oggolaan inaan waligay kaa go'o. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo oo ha idin ilaaliyo, nabadana ha idin siiyo maanta iyo weligeedba. Aamiin.
standing_petitions: Waxaan u baryeynaa Ben iyo dhammaan inta dhimatay, inay nabad iyo iftiin ku helaan gacmaha Masiixa.
Waxaan u baryeynaa qoyska iyo dhammaan kuwa murugaysan, in Ilaah siiyo rajo, xoog, iyo nabad qalbigooda.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Sida aan u daawanayay: Carshiyo ayaa la dhigay, kii waaga horena carshigiisii buu ku fadhiistay. Dharkiisu wuxuu ahaa sida barafka oo kale, timaha madaxiisuna waxay ahaayeen sida dhogorta idaha oo kale; carshigiisu wuxuu ahaa olol dab ah, giraangirihiisuna waxay ahaayeen dab gubanaya. Webiga dabka ah ayaa ka qulqulayay meeshii uu ku fadhiistay; kumanaan kun ayaa u adeegayay, kumanaan kun oo kalena way horyaalayeen. Maxkamaddii ayaa la qabtay, buugaagtiina waa la furay. Sida riyooyinkii habeenkii ay sii socdeen, waxaan arkay mid u eg Wiilka Aadanaha oo daruuraha samada ku imanaya; markuu gaaray kii waaga hore, oo la hor keenay, wuxuu helay dawladnimo, ammaan, iyo boqornimo; dadyowga iyo qowmiyadaha luqad kasta leh ayaa u adeegayay. Dawladnimadiisu waa dawladnimo weligeed ah oo aan meesha ka bixi doonin, boqornimadiisuna ma baabi'i doonto.

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: R. Indhaha malaa'igta hortooda ayaan ammaantaada u gabyi doonaa, Rabbiyow. Waxaan kugu mahadnaqi doonaa, Rabbiyow, qalbigayga oo dhan, waayo waxaad maqashay erayadii afkayga; malaa'igta hortooda ayaan ammaantaada u gabyi doonaa; waxaan ku caabudi doonaa macbudkaaga quduuska ah oo waxaan kugu mahadnaqi doonaa magacaaga. R. Indhaha malaa'igta hortooda ayaan ammaantaada u gabyi doonaa, Rabbiyow. Naxariistaada iyo runtaada aawadeed; waayo waxaad wax walba ka sarraysiisay magacaaga iyo ballankaaga. Markaan kuu yeeray, waad ii jawaabtay; xoog ayaad igu dhistay. R. Indhaha malaa'igta hortooda ayaan ammaantaada u gabyi doonaa, Rabbiyow. Boqorrada dhulka oo dhammu way kugu mahadnaqi doonaan, Rabbiyow, markay maqlaan erayada afkaaga; waxayna u gabyi doonaan jidadka Rabbiga, 'Wayn tahay ammaanta Rabbiga.' R. Indhaha malaa'igta hortooda ayaan ammaantaada u gabyi doonaa, Rabbiyow.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Ciise wuxuu arkay Natana'eel oo u soo socda, wuxuuna ka yiri, 'Waa kan reer binu Israa'iil oo dhab ah. Ma jiro khiyaano ku jirta.' Natana'eel wuxuu ku yiri, 'Sidee baad ii garanaysaa?' Ciise wuxuu u jawaabay oo ku yiri, 'Ka hor inta uusan Filibos kuu yeerin, markaad geedka berdeha hoostiisa joogtay ayaan ku arkay.' Natana'eel wuxuu ugu jawaabay, 'Rabbiyow, adigu waxaad tahay Wiilka Ilaah; adigu waxaad tahay Boqorka reer binu Israa'iil.' Ciise wuxuu u jawaabay oo ku yiri, 'Ma waxaad rumaysatay sababtoo ah waxaan kuu sheegay inaan ku arkay geedka berdeha hoostiisa? Waxaad arki doontaa waxyaabo ka waaweyn kan.' Wuxuuna ku yiri, 'Aamiin, aamiin, waxaan idinku leeyahay, waxaad arki doontaan samada oo u furan, iyo malaa'igta Ilaah oo kor u kacaya oo hoos ugu soo degaya Wiilka Aadanaha.'

day: Feast of Saints Michael, Gabriel, and Raphael, Archangels

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.

Ben ơi, Làm cả ngày tới tối, đến lúc chuẩn bị đi ngủ thì nằm một lúc lại nhớ Ben, nhớ mấy chuyện hai anh em từng nói với nhau. Nghĩ tới em, anh thấy buồn nhiều lắm. Ben hãy luôn theo dõi và cầu nguyện cho ba mẹ và Ryan nhé, nước mắt chảy ngược nó khủng khiếp hơn chảy xuôi đó Ben.

Ben ơi, ba nhớ con nhiều quá.

Mommy cũng vậy. Hơn hai tháng rồi mà ba má vẫn khóc mỗi ngày.

Con giúp ba má vượt qua nha, để lo cho em
